notes: Started clearing a backlog of styles defined twice in the same file — pairs of rules that disagreed, where the second silently won and the first had never rendered. Fourteen are now single definitions, with no visible change: 421,632…

Four were deliberately left alone. In each case another rule sits between the two definitions, and merging them would quietly change which one wins — the kind of one-in-a-thousand change that does not show up in a spot check.
